items.quote: Peers observed that Ashassa Yanington was recognised sector-wide for his leadership of capability building for new hires.
Several respondents noted that Ashassa was recognised sector-wide for his leadership of dashboards tracking service performance metrics.
Ashassa Yanington championed the move of paper-based permit applications to an online portal and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Direct reports said that Ashassa Yanington spearheaded change management after the merger of two units at the national level.
Peers observed that Ashassa Yanington drove the redesign of the citizen journey for permits for the whole division.
Several respondents noted that Ashassa drove reaching a deal with the contractor after weeks of back-and-forth for the whole division.
Peers observed that Ashassa set the direction for accountability arrangements for public funds across the public service.
He handled the five-year strategic plan for the division competently within his team.
Direct reports said that Ashassa drove steadying the unit after its flagship project was cancelled for the whole division.
